description.short: See the Work Items waiting for your decision in Spaarke
description.full: Spaarke skills for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Cowork. Ask what decisions are waiting for you in Spaarke and review them in the decisions widget. This package carries skills only: the Spaarke MCP connector is registered once for the tenant, and you sign in with your Spaarke account. Copilot sees only what that account may see.
